reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Dodoco Blast for 7 damage to all enemies, then Kaboom! for 7 damage to Shrinker Beetle, then Duck and Cover for 5 Block. This used both Sparks, 2 Energy, and left 1 Energy unused.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I considered Tinder Toss, Kaboom!, and Duck and Cover. It would have dealt 11 total damage instead of 14 and left 1 Spark unused, so it was worse with only one enemy and no stated future Spark use.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up playing Tinder Toss and the 1 Spark that would have remained if I had played Tinder Toss instead of Dodoco Blast. It did not give up Block or the single-target attack, because Duck and Cover and Kaboom! were still played.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. An attack intent would make Duck and Cover more clearly useful, but I already played it. A different non-attack intent would not make Tinder Toss preferable to Dodoco Blast with one enemy and no other stated information.
